'''RamapoCon II Team Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in H-wing Auditorium, Ramapo College, New Jersey on 7 May 2000. Charlie's Angels (team: [[Jonny Chu]], [[Charlie Herren]], [[Steve Brentson]], [[Michael Dalton]]) won it. It is known from Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d714">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-reportd714/ ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-report], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 9 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-reportd714/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[RamapoCon II]].

* '''Date:''' 7 May 2000
* '''Site:''' H-wing Auditorium, Ramapo College, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 38
* '''Winner:''' Charlie's Angels (team: [[Jonny Chu]], [[Charlie Herren]], [[Steve Brentson]], [[Michael Dalton]])

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Lingrell's text says the late arrivals made '7 teams of 4 and 2 teams of 3', but his results table lists 10 teams and 38 participants; Jonathan Chu's report says 9 teams.<ref name="tr-d714" />
* Jonathan Chu says 9 teams played the team tournament; Scott Lingrell's director's report lists 10 teams (38 players).<ref name="tr-d708">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-final-report-5-6-5-7-2000d708/ ramapocon-ii-final-report-5-6-5-7-2000], DeckTech (Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, 9 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-final-report-5-6-5-7-2000d708/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
